newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker steady amid uninspiring enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker steady amid uninspiring enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were little changed from Friday amid thin enquiries, brokers said on Monday.
They said this is in spite of firmer cargo prices.
Majors were quoting bunker 180-cst at $115 per tonne and 380-cst at $108 per tonne. Independents were quoting $113 for 180-cst and at $108 for 380-cst.
Shipowners remained at the sidelines, said a trader.
MDO was talked in a wide range in the thin market of $185-$195 and gas oil at $203-$205, unchanged from Friday.
